title: Speed up complete P104 precision replay with proved exact integer arithmetic
body:
The complete current P104 precision replay now uses exact dyadic integers in its ideal-input, signed-error and transpose inner loops. On six serial fresh-process measurements, the local median falls **24.091 to4.301 seconds:5.60x, or82.1% less wall time**. All25,984 events,799 input coordinates, final signed coefficients, guards, attaining fixtures and six original rejection controls remain active.

The scale is proved from both traversal directions; each integer division checks exactness. The frozen source export stays unchanged. Four declared edits add ordinary source/backend parameters to the copied contract runner. There is no runtime monkeypatch, import hook, modular acceptance, floating acceptance or persistent cache.

Qualification compares the complete baseline/candidate output, all actual signed witness rows, ideal metadata and exact local weights. It adds120 dyadic programs with4,240 events and three rejection controls. The registered full qualification took36.35seconds locally; that separate cost is not included in the fast-path speedup. Registered Python3.12, committed-byte/mode, source-corruption and sealed read-only Git-free optimized qualification pass.

The host was not reserved. Baseline runs span19.791–31.149seconds; candidate runs span3.259–9.810seconds. Every run and code hash is retained in BENCHMARK.json. These are local macOS measurements, not a Linux or hosted CI guarantee. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout; hosted CI and independent scientific review remain pending.

This changes verification cost, not the precision theorem, word or kappa. Native unitary gauges, physical resets, exact owned return, compiler, precision-tape and analytic admission retain their prior status. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19209571).

Source PR5826: `58f93cf41751920f3d6766a39caccc2974ce18b0`. Credit PR5819, Adam Gall, ywz65, PR2878, Mason Hale/PR5811 and all retained P104 sources. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. CI dependency is the unchanged PR5761 test-only repair `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, with original authorship/provenance retained.


Clean-checkout source repair: the initial hosted job could not resolve pending predecessor commits. SOURCES.json now binds the exact retained input copies in this PR history; retained_predecessors preserves every original head, path, blob and SHA256 plus the retained file/archive member. Original and retained bytes were checked equal. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and declared-pin ancestry checks pass. Source bytes, mathematical assertions and scientific receipts are unchanged. The full-history preflight remains unrun in this shallow checkout. Hosted replay is queued for the new head.
